transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the necessity for performance optimization within the autonomous driving system. Requirements EFF-01 and EFF-02 ensure that the system reduces travel time and maintains passenger comfort, which is crucial for user satisfaction. EFF-03 guarantees that safety protocols do not compromise performance, while EFF-04 ensures real-time responsiveness, vital for effective operation. EFF-05 and EFF-06 focus on achieving high success rates in speed profile generation and handling obstacle constraints efficiently. EFF-07 prioritizes smoothness during emergency maneuvers, which is essential for maintaining comfort even in critical situations. These performance requirements must be upheld to achieve an effective autonomous driving experience.
